scope: Frozen-kernel, complete-spectrum, conditional stress-reference field; no production significance replacement
fractional_kernel_rule: log-linear interpolation between frozen adjacent integer states, inherited from v5.1.1
validation: Reuse first256 archived coherent Poisson spectra; first128 for empirical standardization, second128 holdout; do not claim extreme tail validation
response: Full stress spectrum plus each bin shifted upward by sqrt(truth count); exact GP retraining for each count spectrum at frozen kernel
reporting: Report signed observed root, deterministic stress offset, response SD, conditional centered Z, gated and ungated probabilities, direct finite-toy tail, same-node invariance, and paired maximum changes. All choices fixed before new fits.

amendment.reason: Expand half-step comparison to complete original domain for uniform and interpretable grid convergence; runtime benchmark 6.3 seconds per new node permits completion. No selection on new significance outcomes.

numerical_amendment.method: Exact Sherman-Morrison update for Asimov single-bin perturbation; truth and all Poisson draws keep exact cached Cholesky.
numerical_amendment.gate: Compare all721 roots and response SD with frozen exact archive at100 and150 MeV; max root discrepancy below2e-5 required. Per new node compare moments to exact Cholesky at first/middle/last training bin; max relative mean error<2e-8 and covariance Frobenius relative error<2e-5. On per-node gate failure use exact Cholesky.
numerical_amendment.profile_speedup: Replace unoptimized three-factor einsum Hessian with algebraically identical batched matrix multiplication. Same archived-all-root and per-batch scalar gates apply; scalar reference remains exact fallback.
